facts.fact: The Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy says its Innovation Village pilot, with Huawei, Glo and the Universal Service Provision Fund, delivers free public Wi-Fi at 100 Mbps to over 12,000 residents of the rural settlement of Ibwa 2, Kura, Gwagwalada.

systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy

facts.fact: The Federal Ministry says the Innovation Village pilot in Ibwa 2 includes community training sessions on digital literacy and device maintenance, with scaling to more rural communities planned after a quarter's evaluation.

NGA.note: The Universal Service Provision Fund is named as a partner with no amount, budget year or statement.
Classrooms at one pilot site only; no share or curriculum statement.
